definitions.explanation: A group of people born and living around the same time; also refers to a stage in technological or product development.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧{世代|せだい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦SNS→SNS：05601_esuenuesu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: The younger generation uses social media a lot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世代間|せだいかん}→世代間：28752_sedaikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ギャップ→ギャップ：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧{世代|せだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スマートフォン→スマートフォン：04434_sumaatofon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The next-generation smartphone will be released.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧{世代|せだい}: young generation
- ⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{世代|せだい}: older generation
- {世代|せだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧: to transcend generations
- ⟦{世代間|せだいかん}→世代間：28752_sedaikan⟧⟦ギャップ→ギャップ：noentry⟧: generation gap
- ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧{世代|せだい}: next generation
- ⟦{新|しん}{世代|せだい}→新世代：noentry⟧: new generation

COMMON GENERATION TERMS:
- ⟦{団塊|だんかい}→団塊：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{世代|せだい}: baby boomer generation
- ⟦ゆとり→ゆとり：10652_yutori⟧{世代|せだい}: yutori generation (born 1987–2004)
- Z{世代|せだい}: Generation Z
